Description: Allow users to authenticate using work email and password. Handle rate limiting and session refresh.
Acceptance Criteria: Given valid credentials; When user submits login form; Then user receives JWT auth token | Given invalid password; When submitted; Then system returns 401 Unauthorized

Description: Users can review items in cart and complete checkout with credit card or mobile money.
Acceptance Criteria: Given non-empty cart; When user enters valid card; Then order is placed with confirmation ID | Given expired card; When submitted; Then user sees friendly card decline error

Description: Enable customers to view live geolocation coordinates of their dispatch rider on a map.
Acceptance Criteria: Given active shipment; When customer opens tracking link; Then map updates rider location every 5 seconds

Description: System automatically compiles tax compliant invoice and attaches to confirmation email.
Acceptance Criteria: Given completed payment; When order state transitions to paid; Then PDF invoice is generated and emailed within 30s

Description: Admins can assign QA Lead or Viewer roles to members to restrict defect deletion.
Acceptance Criteria: Given user with Viewer role; When viewing defects; Then delete and edit buttons are disabled
